integrity: Analytic proof with explicit weakly-null tent vectors. Independent audit and external proof certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes connected infinite locally finite simple graphs, unweighted edges, root-plus-Lipschitz norm and bounded multipliers. Exactness is claimed only for symbols tending to zero; no general exact formula for positive A is given. Older unpublished graph-multiplier sources could affect priority.
title: An oscillation lower bound for essential norms of graph Lipschitz multipliers
